---
name: hub-index
description: Update Ventura Studio repository indexes from verifiable repository metadata and declared maturity. Use when adding removing renaming or reclassifying ecosystem projects. Do not use when changing code inside a project rather than the ecosystem catalog.
---

# Hub index

- Verify the repository exists under the Ventura Labs AI account before adding it.
- Read its current README and engineering evidence before assigning a category or maturity.
- Preserve the distinction between flagship incubation curation and supporting framework.
- Link to the canonical repository name and URL.
- Do not infer production-grade status from badges README claims or repository age.
- Update only the index sections affected by the verified change.
- Run repository checks after editing.
